tasks.instruction: Can you look at the data in this binary: static? The given BASH script ltdis.sh might help! What is the flag?
In what year did the country in which Barbara Kingsolver lived for part of her childhood gain independence from its colonial ruler?
Find all duplicate files (based on MD5 hash) in /testbed and its subdirectories. Output each set of duplicates on a single line, separated by spaces.
tasks.gold_command: find /testbed -type f -exec md5sum {} + | sort | awk 'a[$1]++{if(a[$1]==2)printf "\n%s %s ", b[$1], $2; else printf "%s ", $2}{b[$1]=$2}END{print ""}'
